name: Feed
description: Every note that isn't archived, pinned ones first, then newest change first, as cards grouped by day: its title, a few lines, and who changed it and when. Embeds in a card are a quiet line saying what they are. By touch, swipe a card right to archive it and left to move it to Trash (the feed.swipe settings), long-press to select several, and Undo on the notice takes it back. With a keyboard: j and k move, ↵ opens, e archives, # or dd moves to Trash, p pins, x selects, u undoes. New changes while you're scrolled down wait under a pill. On a phone it's the Feed on the bottom bar, and what the app opens on.

files:read.why: Show a few lines of each note in its card, and the pinned ones in their order

files:write.why: Archive, pin and move notes to Trash when you swipe them or press their keys, as changes by you that Undo takes back

feed.swipe.right.description: What swiping a card right does, by touch: archive it (green), move it to Trash (red), pin or unpin it, or nothing.

feed.swipe.left.description: What swiping a card left does, by touch: move it to Trash (red), archive it (green), pin or unpin it, or nothing.
